tagline: Turn Zoom meeting action items into Jira tickets automatically
metaTitle: Jira + Zoom Integration: Meeting Action Items to Jira
metaDescription: Leave sprint calls with work already in Jira. GAIA turns Zoom planning decisions into sprint items and logs retro action items as tasks. See the setup steps.
intro:
Enterprise engineering teams run their sprint ceremonies — planning, refinement, standups, retrospectives — over Zoom. Every meeting generates action items, decisions, and issue updates that need to land in Jira. Without automation, a dedicated note-taker manually transcribes outcomes into tickets after every call, a process that's slow, incomplete, and unsustainable at scale.

GAIA connects the two so meeting outcomes become tickets automatically. Sprint planning calls generate new tickets for committed items. Standups with flagged blockers create or update impediments. Retrospective action items land in the team's backlog with the appropriate labels. Meeting summaries are attached to relevant tickets for traceability.

For distributed enterprise teams where most cross-team coordination happens over video, every decision made on a call is captured and tracked in Jira.

useCases.title: Sprint planning to Jira sprint
useCases.description: After a sprint planning call, GAIA processes the transcript and creates stories for each committed item, assigns them to the engineers who accepted ownership, and adds them to the active sprint.

useCases.title: Standup blocker tracking
useCases.description: When an engineer mentions a blocker during a standup, GAIA creates or updates the relevant ticket with an impediment flag and notifies the Scrum Master to schedule a resolution.

useCases.title: Retrospective action items as Jira tasks
useCases.description: GAIA processes retrospective meeting transcripts and converts process improvement actions into tasks, assigned to the appropriate owners and labeled for tracking across sprints.

useCases.title: Meeting summary on linked issues
useCases.description: When a meeting is specifically linked to an issue, GAIA attaches a concise AI-generated summary to the ticket as a comment so any team member can understand what was discussed.

useCases.title: Sprint ceremony scheduling
useCases.description: GAIA schedules Zoom meetings for sprint start and end dates automatically, inviting all sprint assignees and including the sprint goal and issue list in the meeting agenda.

howItWorks.step: Connect Jira and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Jira instance and Zoom account in GAIA's settings. Enable cloud recording with transcription (available on Pro and above) for automatic action item extraction.

howItWorks.step: Tag sprint meetings for ticket processing
howItWorks.description: Add a GAIA keyword to meeting titles or use calendar metadata to indicate which meetings are sprint ceremonies. GAIA applies the appropriate workflow to each meeting type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA processes meetings and updates issues
howItWorks.description: After each tagged meeting, GAIA reads the transcript, extracts action items and decisions, and creates or updates issues automatically. A summary is posted for team review.

faqs.question: Does GAIA need Zoom cloud recording enabled?
faqs.answer: Cloud recording with transcription provides the best results. For teams without it, GAIA can also process a pasted meeting summary or notes document to extract action items.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create Jira epics, stories, and sub-tasks from a single planning meeting?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA infers the appropriate issue type from the meeting context. High-level items become epics or stories while granular tasks become sub-tasks under the relevant story.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create duplicate issues from recurring standup mentions?
faqs.answer: GAIA checks for existing open issues before creating new ones. If a matching open issue exists, it adds a standup update comment rather than creating a duplicate ticket.

faqs.question: Can GAIA link meeting recordings to issues for reference?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can attach the cloud recording link to all issues created from that meeting, providing a permanent video reference alongside the extracted action items.
